name: Teeth & Love
source:
Eric was a guy who decided to take a trip to the beach in order to cool off during the summer time. Little did he know he would encounter someone at the beach, but not the type of person he was expecting. 

[From [url=https://brokenanimation.itch.io/teeth-love]Itch.io[/url]]
